facts.business: Tata Capital Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) and a subsidiary of Tata Sons Private Limited, operating as a comprehensive financial ecosystem offering lending and other financial solutions across India.

key_risks: Credit risk and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) estimation involving significant management judgment and assumptions
Liquidity risk and maturity mismatches between financial assets and liabilities
Interest rate risk and currency risk in non-trading portfolios
Regulatory capital adequacy and compliance with RBI guidelines
facts.related_party_note: During the financial year ended March 31, 2026, the Company allotted 18,38,67,495 equity shares to TMF Holdings Limited (shareholder of Tata Motors Finance Limited) as consideration other than cash, and conducted a rights issue of 5,10,74,292 equity shares at ₹343 per share.
